n0.text: I'm Colby! Like the cheese! Well, Colby-Jack. Jack is my brother. He's a rind of a different colour.

n1.text: I saw a rat in the corn yesterday. It was THIS big. Okay, maybe THIS big. Okay, normal rat-size. But scary!

r0.text: Did you know cows have four stomachs? I only have one. I am at a disadvantage.
